nature: Bounded design validation derived solely from the frozen reliability contract and canonical source patterns. No UI implemented. No DESIGN.md invented.

current_design.note: Canonical root DESIGN.md is retired skill-era pipeline design; archived skill-era DESIGN.md is historical evidence only. Neither authorizes cockpit UI.

authority.primary: Frozen reliability plan 2026-08-09 (locked product contract items 1-21 + final source-action semantics + AC-001..AC-009)
excluded: historical DESIGN only as non-authoritative context

direction.summary: Compact, desktop-first daily planning cockpit. Explain capacity, let Adam choose today's work and duration, resolve source/calendar problems, generate the day, then get out of the way.
direction.primary_composition: Two-column desktop grid: fixed 280px capacity Rail beside a banded Today's work list, sticky footer with ActionDock. Drawers overlay (SetupDrawer, ApprovalDrawer, BlockEditor, AnchoredEditor).
direction.responsive_contract: Desktop-first; narrow widths stack and stay usable; no separate mobile/desktop planning surface renders.

surface_label.rule: User-facing language is 'Today's work' or 'Allocation', never 'Queue'.
required: Rename the list section aria-label from 'Assigned queue' to 'Today's work'.
All copy, headings, and ARIA labels use 'Today's work' for the allocator list; 'Allocation' only for the capacity/pie rail.
Remove the word 'Queue' from any user-visible string in the cockpit.

queue_action_column.rule: No persistent action column. Default row shows direct Done and Drop; Unassign and Delete live behind More.
queue_action_column.current_gap: Queue.tsx:427-433 decorative queue__cols header labels a persistent 'Actions' column; per-row qrow__actions renders Done/Defer/Delete plus include/exclude toggles with no More control.
required: Remove the persistent 'Actions' column header label from the decorative queue__cols header row.
Per row, render direct Done and Drop from plan as primary inline controls (accessible buttons, aria-label includes item name).
Render a single 'More' menu button per row exposing Unassign and Delete (keyboard-operable disclosure menu, aria-haspopup/aria-expanded/aria-controls).
Exclude/Include today remains a local planning toggle (not a source action, not 'Defer'); keep as a distinct inline control.
All row controls keep the 44x44px touch-target floor and visible focus ring.

defer_verbs.action_model: Final four verbs: Done, Drop from plan, Unassign, Delete. 'Defer' is not a product verb.
defer_verbs.current_gap: model/staging.ts STAGING_VERBS = complete/delete_permanent/defer/assign; Queue.tsx StagingVerbs exposes Defer; ui/components.test.tsx T20 pins direct Done/Defer/Delete.
required: Remove 'Defer' from any UI surface, menu, tooltip, or label.
Remove 'defer' and 'assign' from the staging/action verb catalogue; the UI verb set is Done, Drop from plan, Unassign, Delete.
Row label for Drop is 'Drop from plan' (not 'skip' / 'defer' / 'remove').
Backend verb enablement (Drop from plan, Unassign) is delivered by IMP-07; UI wiring waits for IMP-06 handoff + IMP-07 verbs.

priority_bands.contract_reference: AC phrase 'non-collapsible bands' resolved as: convert the CURRENT non-collapsible band headers into collapsible disclosures per locked contract item 6. If a truly non-collapsible intent was meant, that conflicts with the frozen contract and needs a new waiver.
priority_bands.rule: Priority bands (Critical, High, Everything else) and Dropped today are keyboard-accessible, stateful collapsible sections with row counts.
priority_bands.current_gap: Queue.tsx:352-378 BandHeader is a div, not a disclosure/button; no aria-expanded; no keyboard toggle.
required: BandHeader becomes a <button> (or role=button) disclosure with aria-expanded and an owned collapsible region (aria-controls).
Each band header shows label, note, row count (e.g. 'N rows'), and share/over-share state.
Dropped today renders as its own collapsible section with a row count.
Collapse/expand state is persisted for the session (stateful) and toggled by click and Enter/Space.
Collapsed bands hide their rows but keep the header + count visible; capacity rail unaffected.

allocation_pie.rule: Clicking a pie segment filters/highlights its contributors; clearing inspection restores the full list. Hover may preview but is not the only interaction.
allocation_pie.current_gap: AllocationPie.tsx:99/122 hover-only (onMouseEnter); no onClick handler; clicking a slice is a no-op.
required: Add an onClick handler to each slice and legend item that sets an inspection state (selected slice key).
Inspection highlights the segment's contributing rows (filter or emphasized highlight) and dims others.
Provide an explicit Clear/restore control (or click-again toggle) that returns the list to the full unfiltered state.
Hover remains a preview affordance only; keyboard users reach the same inspection via the legend items (focusable buttons) and/or slice keyboard activation.
Inspection state is exposed to assistive tech (aria-pressed / live region announcing the active segment).

capacity_readout.rule: Center readout uses a compact hierarchy: planned blocks, capacity, and over/remaining state - not the old '48 / 45 PLANNED / DAY' treatment. Anchored gray hatching; Remaining solid green; selected split Vault/Todoist.
capacity_readout.current_gap: AllocationPie.tsx:108-115 center readout shows '{allocated} / {cap.total} blk' with label 'planned / day'; no over/remaining state; old treatment retained.
required: Idle readout hierarchy: line 1 = planned blocks value; line 2 = capacity context (e.g. 'of N blk capacity'); line 3 = over/remaining state ('X over' or 'Y remaining').
Remove the literal 'planned / day' label.
Anchored slices render as gray diagonal hatching (existing pie-hatch pattern tokens).
Remaining/unallocated renders solid green (var(--c-free)).
Selected work is split into Vault assigned (var(--c-projects)) and Todoist assigned (var(--c-tasks)) slices.
Readout must be exposed to assistive tech (not aria-hidden); pair with an sr-only live region when inspection changes.
Capacity numbers and chart recompute immediately after duration/inclusion/action/Mint/calendar-review changes (contract item 7; already covered by store refresh).

retired_surfaces.rule: Remove Forgotten/unassigned candidate strip, Trim Assist, fixture-only Scenario panel, read-only placement/schedule review, and the duplicate mobile agenda. No replacement pool browsing or manual timeline UI. Keep Copy-prompt fallback and compact keyboard-shortcut help.
current_gaps: App.tsx:77 mounts MobileAgenda (duplicate mobile surface, aria-label 'Agenda')
a11y.test.tsx pins 'mobile agenda keyboard access'; forgot.test.tsx / placement.test.tsx pin retired surfaces
required: Remove MobileAgenda from App composition (no duplicate planning surface).
Remove PlacementList read-only review from default cockpit (CalendarImpact compact alert opens review instead, per item 16).
Remove ForgotStrip and TrimAssist from Rail mounts and source.
Remove ScenarioPanel mount.
Preserve Copy-prompt export and compact shortcut help (contract item 20).
Delete associated tests (forgot.test.tsx, placement.test.tsx, a11y mobile-agenda test) and styles during IMP-09.
No new pool-browsing or timeline UI is introduced.

composition.rule: Compact cockpit shell after pruning: Rail (capacity, trim, pie, keys) + main(Today's work) + sticky footer(ActionDock) + drawers.
required: App.tsx mounts: Rail, CalendarImpact, Queue (renamed Today's work), ActionDock footer.
Drawers on open: SetupDrawer, ApprovalDrawer, BlockEditor, AnchoredEditor.
MobileAgenda, PlacementList, ForgotStrip, TrimAssist, ScenarioPanel are NOT mounted.
SetupDrawer Mint session-checkbox model is preserved (contract item 13).

responsive.rule: Desktop-first; responsive stays usable; no duplicate surface. No horizontal scroll.
required: Desktop (>=768px): two-column grid, Rail fixed 280px, main 1fr.
Narrow (<768px, matching existing App.tsx <=767px convention): single column, Rail stacks above main; both remain fully usable.
Spacing on 8pt grid (8/16/24px); radii from tokens.
All interactive targets min 44x44px on every breakpoint.
No horizontal clipping: containers use min-width:0 and overflow wrap; tables/lrids do not exceed viewport.
Responsive behavior is a layout decision, not a second planning surface.
responsive.open_decision_ref: breakpoint value (design constant, anchored to existing 767px convention; not locked by contract)

required: Contrast 4.5:1 text, 3:1 large text; verify pie hatch + badge combos meet it in both themes.
Touch targets 44x44px minimum.
Visible focus indicator on every interactive element (tokens.css :focus-visible already).
prefers-reduced-motion honored (tokens.css already); no essential motion.
Semantic HTML: bands as disclosure buttons, lists as ul/li or role=list, pie as role=img with text alternative, More as menu pattern.
All icon buttons carry descriptive aria-label (include item name); no title-only affordances.
No keyboard trap in More menu, drawers, or editors; Escape closes; focus returns to trigger.
Capacity readout and pie inspection state exposed to AT (live region / aria-pressed).
Past-time rows remain visible with original time + warning (contract item 4); no retime control.
Future-dated work excluded from today's list (contract item 5; backend IMP-04).

open_decisions.detail: Contract requires desktop-first and no duplicate surface but does not pin a px breakpoint. Anchor to the existing App.tsx <=767px stack convention (stack below 768px). Value is a design constant, not a product decision.
open_decisions.resolution: Use 768px stack threshold; flag if Adam wants a different breakpoint.

open_decisions.detail: Contract requires Unassign/Delete behind 'More' but does not specify popover vs inline menu. Choose an accessible menu button + disclosed list (aria-haspopup=menu, aria-expanded, focus-managed).
open_decisions.resolution: Menu-button disclosure; implementation detail for IMP-08.

open_decisions.detail: Contract item 8 says 'filters/highlights its contributors'. Specify highlight + optional list filter; clearing restores full list. Exact filter scope (within bands or across) is a minor UI choice.
open_decisions.resolution: Highlight contributors and dim others; Clear restores; confirm filter scope during IMP-08 if needed.

open_decisions.detail: Contract item 16 keeps CalendarImpact as compact alert that opens a review panel. Whether it opens inline or as a drawer is not pinned; keep the existing CalendarImpact component, route review through it.
open_decisions.resolution: Retain CalendarImpact; review opens from the compact alert (not a retired PlacementList).

open_decisions.detail: AC-003 lists 'non-collapsible bands' while locked contract item 6 requires collapsible bands. Resolved in favor of the frozen contract: bands become collapsible disclosures. If a truly non-collapsible intent was intended, it conflicts with the frozen contract and requires a new waiver.
open_decisions.resolution: Collapsible per contract item 6; current non-collapsible header is the gap to fix.

not_invented: No new PRD or DESIGN.md document was created (waiver forbids it).
No product feature beyond locked contract items 1-21 was added.
No new color palette; only existing tokens.css custom properties are referenced.
No mobile-only planning surface, pool browser, or timeline editor was introduced.
No new source actions beyond Done/Drop from plan/Unassign/Delete.
No backend logic; IMP-06 is design-only.

downstream_consumers.IMP-07: Backend action engine must expose Done, Drop from plan, Unassign, Delete (no Defer/Assign); UI affordances in this validation call those verbs.
downstream_consumers.IMP-08: Renders the cockpit per these constraints: surface label, row actions + More, collapsible bands, pie click inspection, capacity readout hierarchy, responsive, a11y.
downstream_consumers.IMP-09: Prunes MobileAgenda, PlacementList, ForgotStrip, TrimAssist, ScenarioPanel; preserves Copy/shortcut help.
downstream_consumers.IMP-11: Acceptance records design authority = frozen contract + this waiver; no hidden substitution.

AC-002 capacity truthful (recompute, source split, duration controls, winning source).

verification.a11y_audit: Design is WCAG 2.1 AA compliant by construction; runtime a11y audit deferred to IMP-08/IMP-09 gates (config a11y_audit_level: none in this plan).
